# 6D Torsional Action Principle Architecture

This directory serves as the automated machine-readable index for the 6D Torsional Action Principle framework. It is optimized for LLMs, RAG configurations, and AI research agents.

## Core Thesis
The 6D Torsional Action Principle provides a geometric resolution to the cosmological Hubble Tension. By constructing a background-independent 6-dimensional bulk space decomposed topologically into M⁴ × (ℝ⁺ × S¹), local torsional metrics generate an effective multi-scale chameleon scalar field profile. This alters the local early universe sound horizon calculations without fine-tuning free parameters.
